title: Purair® ECO Green Performance Ductless Fume Hoods
meta_title: Purair ECO Ductless Fume Hoods - High Efficiency Air Filtration
meta_description: The Purair ECO Series high efficiency ductless fume hoods protect the user and the environment from hazardous vapors generated on the work surface.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, purair eco, air filtration, hazardous vapors, work surface protection
short_description: The Purair® ECO Series high efficiency ductless fume hoods protect the user and the environment from hazardous vapors generated on the work surface.
full_description: A high capacity air handling system delivers face velocity of 100 FPM. Improved clamping prevents bypass leakage. Ergonomic arm rest for user comfort. The filter assembly is easy to access, easy to change.
seo_content: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair ECO creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Capsule Filling / Chemical Sampling / Dental / Drug and Chemical Analysis / Forensics / Histology/ Ink Fumes / LEEDS Installations / Light Grinding / Pharmaceuticals / Pipetting / Slide Staining / Spray Adhesives / Weighing

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
